svg.text: Impulse response: which accumulator does each grid cell permanently move?
D sees col[3:0] AND row[3:0] → fan-in 11
D sees only the previous stage → fan-in 3
cell index of the single injected star, raster order, 11 per row

The bimodal fan-in is visible as shape. Column rows are strictly periodic with period 11, so those counters are addressed by the column index alone. Region rows are 2-D blobs, so those need the row index too.
